id.description: Lower case, digits and hyphens. A built-in board's id (home, projects, organization…) replaces that board.

name.description: The board's title. "{org}" is replaced by the org's name.

audience.description: members, council, public, or a role id from governance.yaml. Until sign-in every local actor sees every board.

$comment: data/boards.yaml (P4 spec §5.1). Block types, sources, views and places are checked by lib/board-query.mjs validateBoard, which validateEntry runs for this registry.
